theorems.statement: ∀ (d P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid d)) (B : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P) (J : Euclid d → ℝ), MeasurableSet B → ContinuousOn G B → InjOn G B → Measurable J → (∀ v, 0 ≤ J v) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ w in G '' B, g w ∂μ = ∫⁻ v in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J v) * g (G v) ∂ν) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ w in G '' B, f w ∂μ = ∫ v in B, J v * f (G v) ∂ν
